fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: Fetched by useEnvData as ?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:37). The submitted form value is not the raw id: mapLocationOptions encodes 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when location_type is set and falls back to the bare id otherwise (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36). Static param is repeated (array).

fields.query_param_normalization: single value (searchParams.get); resolved against loaded location options by encoded value, provider id, or display name (resolveLocationFormValue, ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:62-77); unresolvable -> site and device cleared; skipped once any field has been changed manually (single isManualChange flag, ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:84-102)

fields.name: ufm_device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the UFM device used to inspect the InfiniBand fabric.

options.notes: Request suppressed until site is non-empty; the encoded site value is decoded into site=<id> plus site_type=<location_type> query params (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-56). Rows map name -> label, id -> value (useDevices.ts:59-61). No managed_only (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:69-75). Cleared on every site change (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:135-138).

fields.query_param_normalization: single value (searchParams.get('device')); kept only if present in the loaded UFM device options, otherwise cleared; skipped after any manual change (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:104-118)
client_only_validation: non-empty after trim ('Device is required'); schema has no minLength

fields.name: switch_device_ids
fields.label: Device IDs
fields.schema_description: Identifiers of the InfiniBand switches to validate.

options.notes: Request suppressed until site is non-empty; the encoded site value is decoded into site=<id> plus site_type=<location_type> query params (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-56). Rows map name -> label, id -> value (useDevices.ts:59-61). No managed_only (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:76-82). Cleared on every site change (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:135-138).

fields.query_param_normalization: multi-value (searchParams.getAll('device-id')); filtered to values present in the loaded MLNX-OS options (none valid -> []); not split on commas; skipped after any manual change (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:47-51,120-133)
client_only_validation: at least one ('Device IDs is required'); schema has maxItems 1000 but no minItems

payload_transform: {ufm_device_id: values.device, switch_device_ids: values.deviceIds}; site is dropped (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:144-147). startWorkflow POSTs to /v1/workflow/ngc/infiniband_cable_validation; 2xx redirects to /workflows/{id}; error -> destructive toast with getErrorMessage(error); isSubmitting reset after either outcome (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:140-160).
discrepancies: UI labels are misleading relative to the schema: 'Device' is the UFM device (ufm_device_id) and 'Device IDs' are the switches (switch_device_ids); schema descriptions are not shown.

Query-param naming is inverted relative to DeviceWorkflowForm forms: 'device' pre-fills ufm_device_id and repeated 'device-id' pre-fills switch_device_ids, whereas elsewhere 'device-id' is the single target device.
site is UI-only; InfinibandCableValidationInput has no site field.
Client-only: ufm_device_id non-empty and at least one switch (schema: no minLength; maxItems 1000 but no minItems).
Option filters are platform-based (UFM / MLNX-OS) with no managed_only, unlike the IB Port GUID Discovery form that submits the same field names (role=UFM / managed_only=true).

A single isManualChange flag means any manual edit stops URL prefill for all three fields (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandcablevalidationworkflow/form/infiniband-validation-workflow-form.tsx:43,162-164).
Docs screenshot spec passes role, status and tenant query params that this form never reads (ui/tests/docs-screenshots/workflowForms.spec.ts:451-461).

e2e 'handles invalid URL parameters' builds device-id with join(',') (ui/tests/e2e/ibCableValidationForm.spec.ts:271-274) but the form reads repeated params via getAll and never splits commas; it passes only because a single value is used.
contract_gaps: BLOCKING for generic: site is not an input-model field, so it cannot carry a UiHint, and depends_on {site: site} cannot reference it because dependencies must name sibling model fields. Generic support needs either a device_reference widget that embeds its own site scope or a UI-only/virtual field concept.

Site option values are encoded 'dcim-location:[type,id]' and must expand into two device query params (site, site_type) (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-50); depends_on maps one field to one query param with the raw value.
Location options need a repeated static param (location_type=Site&location_type=Module); OptionSource.params values are scalar-only.

Prefill normalization is not expressible: site is resolved by id/name/encoded value, and device / device-id values are dropped unless present in the loaded options; query_param is a bare allowlist with no validate-against-options semantics.
Array prefill from repeated query params (device-id) needs defined array coercion.
device_reference on an array field (switch_device_ids) must render a multi-select and carry a per-field filter (platform=MLNX-OS vs platform=UFM); not defined in v1.
Clearing dependent selections when site changes has no v1 key.
